icons.name: headphones
icons.title: Headphones
icons.motion: The band squeezes in as they go on, then the cups thump to the beat.

icons.name: headset
icons.title: Headset
icons.motion: The mic swings down from its ear cup to the mouth, and the band nods.

icons.name: heart-crack
icons.title: Broken heart
icons.motion: The heart shudders and the crack runs down through it.

icons.name: heart-handshake
icons.title: Partnership
icons.motion: The heart around the clasped hands beats twice.

icons.name: heart-off
icons.title: Unfavorite
icons.motion: The slash strikes through the heart, which flinches.

icons.name: heart-plus
icons.title: Add to favorites
icons.motion: The plus spins in at the corner and the heart beats once to take it.

icons.name: heart-pulse
icons.title: Heart rate
icons.motion: The heart beats twice while the pulse line traces across it.

icons.name: heater

icons.name: message-x

icons.name: metronome
icons.title: Metronome
icons.motion: The arm and its weight tick across and back twice on the pivot.

icons.name: phone-forwarded

icons.motion: The arrow carries on to the right and comes back in, while the handset gives a short ring.

icons.title: Missed call
icons.motion: The cross draws itself, one stroke then the other, as the handset shakes.

icons.name: phone-off
icons.title: Hang up

icons.name: shape-subtract
icons.title: Subtract
icons.motion: The front square pushes in from its corner and the back square gives way where it bites.

icons.name: shape-unite
icons.title: Union
icons.motion: The joined shape pinches in on its middle and swells back out as one.

icons.name: shield-ban
icons.title: Blocked
icons.motion: The ban line cuts through and the shield shakes it off.

icons.name: shield-cog
icons.title: Security settings
icons.motion: The cog turns one tooth on its centre inside the shield.

icons.name: shield-half
icons.title: Partly protected
icons.motion: The dividing line draws up the middle while the shield rocks on its point.

icons.name: shield-lock
icons.title: Secure
icons.motion: The lock drops in front of the shield, its shackle snapping down a beat later; the shield takes the knock.

icons.name: shield-minus
icons.title: Remove protection
icons.motion: The shield gives a little and the minus draws across it.

icons.name: shield-off
icons.title: Protection off
icons.motion: The slash cuts across and the two halves of the shield shift apart along it, then close up.

icons.name: shield-plus
icons.title: Add protection
icons.motion: The shield gives a little and the plus grows in, its bar then its stem.

icons.name: shield-user
icons.title: Account security
icons.motion: The shoulders, then the head, rise into the shield, which gives a little.

icons.name: shield-x
icons.title: Not protected
icons.motion: The shield gives a little and the cross draws itself on it, one stroke after the other.

icons.name: ship
icons.title: Ship
icons.motion: The ship rocks on its keel while the waves roll under it.
